cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: For the Record
cards.instruction: Get someone to state exactly what they did, knew, or authorized before you reveal your own involvement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before I show you the fireworks invoice, state exactly what you approved. I'll take the items in order.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did you buy the enormous rocket?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Approval first, please. Did 'make it memorable' include rockets, or only ground fireworks?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sparklers. Nothing that needed a trailer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Date that restriction for me. Please separate what you meant from what you told me before I give you the delivery date.

reason: Use B's non-answer and new trailer limit as exact targets for inquiry corrections while A delays the purchase disclosure.
